headline: Military English Foundation
threshold: By Lesson 10, introduce yourself, identify basic team and equipment terms, understand simple classroom instructions, and ask for clarification in English.

lessons.title: Introduce yourself
lessons.objective: Sergeant Rivera welcomes a new student to the training center. Say the four new terms clearly. Ask what one means and confirm your understanding in one short sentence.
lessons.focus: English word stress; I am, you are, and professional introductions

words.note: English: A member of an army.

English: A person who teaches a subject.
English: A person who is learning.
English: An account of information.

English: To check that information is correct.
English: To make something understandable.
